goal: Add rate limiting to all API endpoints

steps.name: create rate limiter middleware
steps.prompt: Create a rate limiting middleware in {{middleware_dir}}/rateLimiter.ts. Configure a limit of 100 requests per 15 minutes per IP. Export it as the default export.

steps.name: apply middleware globally
steps.prompt: In {{app_file}}, import the rateLimiter middleware and apply it globally before all route registrations.
